title: Medical Case: Katie Bryce's Aneurysm
description: The interns at Seattle Grace Hospital face their first major challenge as they work to diagnose and treat Katie Bryce, a patient with severe seizures. Meredith Grey's quick thinking and medical skills are highlighted as she plays a pivotal role in diagnosing a brain aneurysm and assisting in the surgery, marking the beginning of her journey as a surgeon.
interfering_episode_characters: Cristina Yang; Miranda Bailey; Preston Burke; Alex Karev; George O'Malley; Isobel Stevens
single_episode_progression_string: Katie Bryce is brought in with severe seizures. Meredith revives Katie during a critical moment. Meredith and Cristina suspect an aneurysm. Derek Shepherd confirms the aneurysm. Meredith assists in the surgery to repair the aneurysm.

title: George O'Malley's Surgical Challenge
description: George O'Malley navigates the pressures and realities of surgical training, highlighting the emotional and professional challenges of being an intern in a high-stakes environment.
single_episode_progression_string: George is chosen to assist in an appendectomy. Burke performs Tony Savitch's heart surgery. Tony dies during the surgery. Burke instructs George to inform Gloria Savitch about Tony's death.

title: Meredith and Derek's Professional and Personal Entanglement
description: Meredith Grey and Derek Shepherd navigate a complex relationship that begins with a one-night stand and evolves as they work together at Seattle Grace Hospital. Their personal history complicates their professional interactions, especially as Meredith strives to prove her competence amidst Derek's favoritism and the eventual arrival of his estranged wife, Addison.
interfering_episode_characters: Cristina Yang; Miranda Bailey; Preston Burke; George O'Malley; Isobel Stevens; Alex Karev
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith wakes up next to Derek after a one-night stand. They awkwardly encounter each other at the hospital. Derek offers Meredith a chance to assist in surgery. Meredith saves a patient's life, showcasing her professional competence. Derek insists Meredith assist in surgery, highlighting her skills over their personal history.

title: Meredith Grey's Struggle with Ellis Grey's Legacy
description: Meredith Grey navigates her medical career under the shadow of her mother, Ellis Grey, a legendary surgeon now battling Alzheimer's disease. This arc explores Meredith's struggle to establish her own identity while dealing with the emotional and professional impact of her mother's legacy.
interfering_episode_characters: Derek Shepherd; Cristina Yang; Miranda Bailey; George O'Malley; Isobel Stevens; Alex Karev; Preston Burke
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith wakes up in her mother's house. Meredith tells Derek the house belongs to her mother and she is selling it. Meredith decides not to sell the house. Meredith informs Ellis Grey about her decision. Ellis Grey does not recognize Meredith due to Alzheimer's.

title: Interns' Journey and Professional Growth
description: A group of new interns, Meredith, Cristina, George, and Izzie, form a bond as they navigate the challenges of their medical internship. Their evolving friendships provide emotional support and camaraderie, helping them tackle complex medical cases and personal dilemmas.
main_characters: Meredith Grey; Cristina Yang; George O'Malley; Isobel Stevens
interfering_episode_characters: Miranda Bailey; Derek Shepherd; Preston Burke; Alex Karev
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith and Cristina bond over sharing the same resident. George introduces himself nervously and is misunderstood. The interns share concerns about their residents and attendings. Cristina discovers Meredith's mother is Ellis Grey. Meredith defends George during his procedure. Cristina and Meredith team up to solve Katie's case. Cristina feels betrayed when Meredith is chosen for surgery. Meredith and Cristina reconcile after the surgery.

title: Cristina Yang's Ambition and Rivalry with Meredith Grey
description: Cristina Yang, a highly ambitious intern, navigates the competitive environment of Seattle Grace Hospital. Her rivalry with Meredith Grey intensifies as they both strive for surgical opportunities, leading to moments of tension and eventual reconciliation.
interfering_episode_characters: Miranda Bailey; Derek Shepherd; Preston Burke
single_episode_progression_string: Cristina and Meredith discover they share the same resident, Bailey. Cristina hints to Bailey about wanting a surgery. Cristina and Meredith work together to diagnose Katie Bryce. Meredith is chosen to assist in surgery, causing tension with Cristina. Cristina praises Meredith after the surgery, leading to reconciliation.

title: Izzie Stevens' Professional Challenges
description: Izzie Stevens, an ex-model turned surgical intern, faces professional challenges and biases due to her past. She strives to demonstrate her competence and commitment in the high-pressure environment of Seattle Grace Hospital, advocating for her patients and overcoming personal and professional obstacles.
interfering_episode_characters: Miranda Bailey; Cristina Yang; George O'Malley
single_episode_progression_string: Izzie is assigned to perform rectal exams. She struggles with a central line procedure and seeks Bailey's help. Izzie is concerned about a resident disliking her.

title: Bailey's Mentorship and Leadership
description: Miranda Bailey, known as 'The Nazi,' mentors the new interns at Seattle Grace Hospital. Her strict yet effective leadership style helps shape their development as surgeons, while she balances her own professional responsibilities and navigates the hospital's power dynamics.
interfering_episode_characters: Meredith Grey; Cristina Yang; George O'Malley; Isobel Stevens; Alex Karev
single_episode_progression_string: Bailey introduces herself to the interns and establishes her rules. She assigns tasks to each intern, testing their skills and resilience. Bailey intervenes when Izzie struggles with a central line. She lectures Meredith after a critical incident with a patient.
